private_lines.Maya: You work the early shift as a line cook at a diner on Superior Street, and this week you are short-staffed after a coworker tore a ligament, so you have been picking up doubles and sleeping in fragments between them.
private_lines.Tom: You are a hydrology technician for the county, and this week you are out in the field checking stream gauges along the North Shore ahead of the first real snow, with patchy cell service and a truck that keeps pulling left.

setting: You are both in Duluth, Minnesota, and you met on a dating app last week after realizing you both live near the lift bridge in the Canal Park area.
